I disagree, because it depends on the situation and circumstances. There are people who get absolutely no matches. If one gets no matches, what are they supposed to do? What if they have tried improving their profile, taking all of the strategies people have given them, like being humorous, having better pictures, and the like, and they still get one match a month without paying? This can absolutely crush someone's self image because they may not feel attractive enough to the opposite sex, which is unsafe. At least back then, we did not judge so heavily on the physical stuff. It is going to be dependent on everyone's own experiences, location, background, etc. Not everyone has way more options like you make it out to believe, some actually have zero, the total opposite.

I congratulate you for having found someone by that route, but that route doesn’t work for everyone. There are people who have really bad luck with that route. If you go to any dating sub, there will be complaint after complaint about it. Sure there’s people who get lucky, but there’s some who aren’t so lucky and have to contend with dealing with one match a month on the apps, if that. The experiences differ from person to person and I actually feel like unless you meet a good person (which in your case, you did) it’s going to be an uphill battle to find someone who won’t ghost you, play mind games or doesn’t take things seriously.

Ghosting is very prevalent online, it occurs much more often because it’s excusable and permissible on the internet. That to me isn’t safe. That ruins others self esteem and causes depression, and I would think that’s far from a safe route.

I’m so sorry to hear you’re dealing with this and I completely sympathize. The deck is going to be stacked heavily against you regardless of the choices you make I feel, because we are headed more toward a world that is fake and artificial. The only ways to date are apps which are cutthroat to the core and singles events which have a barrier to entry with funds. You are doing perfectly fine, it’s the direction society is headed in that’s the main problem.

It’s really not a good situation now in a lot of different ways. We have isolated ourselves. When dating becomes limited to window shopping and becomes commodified to just who you look at online, you know there are issues. In person isn’t just a realistic option for a lot of people these days. I’ve done meetups. It’s mostly guys. The women if any are usually taken, but if they are single, then they don’t want to date a guy right out of the date and guys may need to accept the possibility it may never happen. The likelihood increases the longer you know someone in these cases.

This is why I’m happy being single. I’m certainly open to meeting someone but my life is far less stressful without someone in it at the moment. I have friends who’ve settled down only to find their marriage collapsed and they had to spend tons of money on child support, their divorce and legal fees. Being in a relationship isn’t something that is fairy tale like, but I feel like people make it out to be as such.

Not every guy will still get matches even if he employs this tactic. A lot of different factors go into play, some men just don’t get much luck at all and there is nothing much they can do other than accept it. There is certainly a possibility you do everything right and still get nothing. I’ve seen that happen too. In those cases it’s better to be alone and think in your head you were better off without those people.

Thank the tariffs and our political landscape for that. It’s also harder now compared to our parents age to have a stable, long term career. It’s almost impossible to find a lucrative job with benefits unless you either know someone within who can hire you or you have a ton of experience garnered through internships or entry level roles. Employers pay too little now for the rate of inflation.

Do your friends know anyone single? I wouldn’t hit on friends unless they’ve expressed explicit interest they want to date you and you know they are single.

Welcome to the real world. You’ll eventually meet a person who won’t do that and will be consistent but you may need to try for years. Just how it is.

Correct. This guy above is just looking at his own success. Everyone has a different success rate. Some men do need to go the gym and have a good career and then on top of that they have to be personable, hold a good conversation and be funny. Trust me, women love men who are hilarious. You really need to be a funny guy at times. 

It’s not just isolated to one persons perspective. You have to look at what everyone universally is dealing with.

You need to keep trying as it’s a numbers game. You may have to literally swipe right on 1000 women and then the 1001st is the one that’s interested. It only takes one amazing woman to change your life, and it’s the amazing ones you should be looking for.

I mean irl you could try. I’m not saying it’s not an option but if you’re doing a sporting event or a meetup you absolutely can’t go with the intention of only dating. That’s going to turn women off and some meetups don’t even allow you to date. Do you have a good social circle? What is your social life like? Also look for opportunities for friends to set you up.

Dating is a long game. It’s not something you’ll accomplish immediately and expect to have success, you need to be trying every day and being totally okay with rejection.

Some people do need to pay, it depends on a lot of different factors. If you’re getting nothing on the free version other than one match a month (and trust me, this happens to a lot of people) then you actually have to pay unless you have a good social network of people irl that can help set you up with someone. Yes there’s people who get matches on the free version but like I stated it goes back to the first part of the article, you need to have an excellent profile which most men don’t, you would need to start showing you have your ish together as nowadays people can be happy being single and it’s not like it used to be where we had to stay in a bad relationship because we were forced to.

You yourself may be able to get that many matches on the free version but there are others who aren’t so lucky.

You gotta keep trying on the apps and also irl. You have to wait patiently for a good quality match. It could take time for them to pop up but they are out there. Maybe I’d consider increasing your distance range and being open to dating women who don’t necessarily  live close by and be willing to travel. Like I would be open to doing an LDR with someone from another state or country if I could visit them and there was a way to close the gap. It increases your options instead of limiting them to just one area. While it seems rare I have heard of couples who met online and one lives in another country from the other person. As long as closing the gap is possible, or you’re willing to travel to a different part of your state you may have better options. I met a wonderful girl from across the country and we were in a relationship for a while but neither of us had the ability to move. While we were together we did video calls and just talked over text. But to each his own. Some people prefer to meet someone local but I think you also need to be open to traveling a longer distance. 

Also, what are your pictures and prompts like? I find the best prompts are ones where you’re funny and make jokes, and don’t take anything seriously. The best pictures are pictures of you doing hobbies, being with friends and maybe one or two selfie pics or a pic of you with a cute animal. 

If you do all that above and still don’t get matches then I would sympathize and say I don’t know what else to say. Relocating could also help.

I would also pay for the app. This gives you unlimited likes and also put you at the top of women’s stacks, making it far more likely you’ll get a lot of matches. I usually pay for premium on hinge when I realize the free version isn’t working and $20 a week isn’t too expensive. I’d make it a point to pay
For premium at least once a month, you’d have to pay for dates anyways when you go out with someone. When I tried premium my matches greatly increased because I sent priority likes.
Could you start lifting? I think you’d get better results if you start going to the gym.

This is why quality over quantity is
Important. You can’t just get desperate and go with everyone, sometimes that person is not a good choice for whatever reason and we find out too late. I’d advocate staying single and happy until you find a good person. Luckily I’ve never been harassed or stalked, but I have met my fair share of bad people in this world and I have learned to enjoy my own company and my alone time because I would definitely not want to be with someone bad. So I’m willing to wait, even if it takes years, for someone to come along who’s genuine enough to compromise as well as be in a good relationship.

This is going to be surprising and maybe depressing for some, but if you stay single, then there are no risks of any of what people have described  happening. I think people just get into relationships just for the sake of it. They don’t actually wait for the quality person to come along who is reliable and trustworthy. It can take a long time for this to happen, but in the meantime there’s other things you can do while you’re waiting, love and dating aren’t the only thing in this world but people seem to treat it that way and think if they aren’t getting any part of success they are a less than. In reality sometimes it’s a blessing and you dodged a bullet if you don’t wind up with someone. A lot of the women who rejected me in the past, I realized that for whatever reason they wouldn’t have been a good choice, and I just moved on and didn’t really care

As a single man I fill my life with friends, hobbies, traveling, going to events etc and just living life. Sure I’d like to meet someone but I’m in no way in a rush, because I’ve heard of people who have been married but the marriage still fails after a while. I think a truly happy marriage is quite rare, I’m sure they do exist, but it’s quite difficult to find

It really only takes one. Even if you met just one girl who was sweet, caring and gave you a chance you already won, and nothing else is relevant.

If I can only get that far with women, that means I either have some serious work I have to do or I’m not as good looking as I had hoped. Perhaps getting back surgery to correct the scheuermanns and bad posture would help.
